Lena — thanks for sending this over and for the quick turnaround. I confirmed we have the PDF, but Finance flagged a couple items we need clarified before we can activate the PO: 

1) Beneficial owner / chapter 3 status: the completed form lists the chapter 3 status as a hybrid entity, but the signature block doesn't include the capacity of the signatory (e.g., "Authorized Officer"). Please re-sign with title printed beneath the signature.
2) Notarization / apostille: because Datasentry is a Cayman entity, our tax team requires either a notarized signature page or a short notarization letter confirming the signatory's authority.
3) EIN verification: we will need a supporting doc to corroborate EIN (e.g., a copy of the certificate of incorporation listing the TIN or an IRS CP210 confirmation).

Can you provide a re-signed page with title and one of the two notarization options? If you expect any delay here, let us know — we can provisionally queue the PO but cannot issue payment until verification completes.

Cc'ing Monica from Finance to confirm the list. Karthik — for vendor ops, can you checkpoint the PO slot (PO-2026-0892) and hold for clearance?

Best,
